services.name: Explore the Cranberry Islands
services.desc: 6-6.5 Hours About The Cranberry Islands offer an enchanting escape just a short sail from Mount Desert Island, where you can step back in time to experience authentic coastal Maine at its most pristine. We'll set sail from Southwest Harbor at 10 am and our course to the Cranberry's will depend on wind and tide. Spend your day exploring the villages of Great Cranberry and Little Cranberry (Islesford), wandering past weathered lobster shacks, historic homes, and wildflower-dotted trails with sweeping ocean views. blurb: Guests sail on the Ambergris, a 59-foot traditional Pinky Schooner, exploring Acadia National Park and surrounding islands. Offerings include afternoon sails, sunset cruises, and private charters to the Cranberry Islands. Wildlife sightings may include seabirds, seals, bald eagles, porpoises, and whales.
